item.title: Surviving readout errors and incomplete postselection in monitored quantum circuits
item.description: arXiv:2610.20712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how readout errors affect dynamics in monitored quantum circuits. Such errors make postselection effectively incomplete, conditioning trajectories on imperfect rather than true records. item.title: Quantum prepare-and-measure scenarios: concepts and methods
item.description: arXiv:2610.20725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prepare-and-measure scenarios are among the simplest and most widely used settings for quantum communication. A sender prepares a physical system in one of several possible states, which a receiver then measures.
